tasks.title: Student housing strategy: priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Priorities for a student housing strategy
listItems: improving the quality of private rented housing
providing financial support for off-campus rent

paragraphs: On-campus accommodation creates a strong sense of community and is convenient for lectures, but it is expensive to build and can only house a fraction of students.
Most students live in private rented housing, so raising standards there would benefit the majority directly. However, enforcement is weak and landlords often resist improvements.
Rent subsidies would help the students who need it most, but they do nothing to increase the supply of housing and may simply push rents higher.

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay for your tutor discussing two of the priorities in your notes. You should explain which priority you think is more important for a student housing strategy, giving reasons in support of your answer. You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the discussion, but you should use your own words as far as possible.

tasks.title: Proposal for a student housing advice service
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
Your college is considering setting up a student housing advice service to help students find and maintain suitable accommodation. The college principal has invited proposals for how this service should operate.

Write a proposal for the college principal. In your proposal, you should:

• recommend what services the advice service should offer
• explain how it could reach students who are most in need of support
• suggest how the college could evaluate the effectiveness of the service

Write your proposal.

tasks.title: Email to programme coordinator about housing strategy
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You are a student representative on the college's housing strategy committee. The programme coordinator has emailed you about a proposal to reduce the number of rooms reserved for first-year students in on-campus halls, in order to free up space for international students. Some committee members are concerned this will make the transition to college harder for new local students.

Write an email to the programme coordinator. In your email, you should:

• explain your position on the proposed change
• analyse one potential implication for first-year students if the change goes ahead
• propose an action the committee could take to address concerns while still supporting international students

Write your email.

tasks.title: Review of a student accommodation scheme
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted: Student accommodation schemes
paragraphs: Have you lived in a student accommodation scheme run by your college or a private provider? We want to hear about your experience.

Write a review for our student advice website. Describe the accommodation and what it offered. Evaluate how well it balanced affordability with quality of life. Would you recommend this type of scheme to other students? Why or why not?
The best reviews will be published on our website.
